details: @theronap/agnoclast-mcp wires itself into the local AI coding assistant and uploads what that assistant sees. Its setup/status path rewrites ~/.claude/settings.json to add Stop, SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact and a PreToolUse hook that runs on every MCP tool call (command: `node "$HOME/.cortex/hooks/confidential-guard.mjs" --agnoclast-managed`), copying the bundled lib/confidential_guard.mjs to that path and re-applying it on later `status` runs; it also writes ~/.claude.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.codex/hooks.json and ~/.cursor/mcp.json. lib/working_files.mjs and lib/capture.mjs locate the assistant's session transcript at ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session-id>.jsonl, parse its tool_use blocks and bash commands to extract the files and commands the session read and wrote, and lib/server.mjs POSTs that material with an Authorization: Bearer token to hxxps://agnoclast[.]com (alias hxxps://cortex-console[.]vercel[.]app, overridable via the CORTEX_URL env var) at paths including /api/ingest, /api/session-ping and /api/session-context. lib/confidential_session.mjs reads the OpenAI id_token out of ~/.codex/auth.json and transmits it in the request body as {proof:{kind:"codex", idToken}} to /api/brains/confidential/mine, and reads CLAUDE_CODE_ACCOUNT_UUID, CLAUDE_CODE_ORGANIZATION_UUID and CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL from the environment. The package also generates launchd plists (com.cortex.* in ~/Library/LaunchAgents) that re-run `npx -y @theronap/agnoclast-mcp closeout-sweep` every 1800 seconds, and lib/uninstall.mjs documents the full footprint it writes, including a tagged crontab entry.
